+title: Port DeepseekV4ChatEncoder (DSV4-Flash ships no chat_template)
+---
+## What
+
+Create `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/DeepseekV4ChatEncoder.swift`. **This is required, not optional**: DeepSeek-V4-Flash ships **no `chat_template` in `tokenizer_config.json`** — DeepSeek distributes prompt construction as a separate Python file (`encoding/encoding_dsv4.py`, ~744 LOC). Without this port the model cannot be prompted correctly at all.
+
+Port from `scouzi1966/mlx-swift-lm` @ `main`, `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/DeepseekV4ChatEncoder.swift` (48961 bytes). `osaurus-ai/vmlx-swift-lm` additionally ships a fallback Jinja template at `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ChatTemplates/DSV4Minimal.jinja` — consider carrying that as a secondary path.
+
+Behaviors the reference implements:
+- `chat` vs `thinking` modes.
+- `reasoning_effort=max` preface.
+- `drop_earlier_reasoning` multi-turn rule, **forced off when tools are present**.
+- DSML tool-call encoding (DeepSeek's native tool format — note upstream `ml-explore/mlx-lm` PR #1337 adds a `deepseek_dsml` tool parser for the same format).
+- `tool_result` merging into user `contentBlocks`; `sort_tool_results_by_call_order`.
+- `latest_reminder` role and `developer` role.
+
+Special tokens: `<｜User｜>`, `<｜Assistant｜>`, `<think>` must be treated as specials by the streaming detokenizer. EOS token id is **1**, which decodes to `<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>`; our `TokenizerBridge` should pick that up from `eos_token_id` in `tokenizer_config.json` — verify rather than assume.
+
+Wire into this repo's existing chat plumbing: `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Chat.swift`, `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Tokenizer.swift`, `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ChatSession.swift`. Reasoning and tool-format registration is the next task (`<wiring>`); keep this one to the encoder itself plus the minimum hookup needed to test it.
+
+## Provenance
+- Reference: `scouzi1966/mlx-swift-lm` @ `main` — `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/DeepseekV4ChatEncoder.swift` (MIT; header attributes Osaurus AI).
+- Fallback template: `osaurus-ai/vmlx-swift-lm` — `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ChatTemplates/DSV4Minimal.jinja`.
+- Original Python source of truth: DeepSeek's `encoding/encoding_dsv4.py` shipped in the model repo.
+- Related upstream work: `ml-explore/mlx-lm` PR #1337 (`deepseek_dsml` tool parser).
+- Apply the attribution header decided in task `jhk0apk`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/DeepseekV4ChatEncoder.swift` exists and renders prompts for: plain chat, thinking mode, `reasoning_effort=max`, multi-turn with `drop_earlier_reasoning`, and a tools-present turn.
+- [ ] `drop_earlier_reasoning` is demonstrably forced off when tools are present.
+- [ ] DSML tool-call encoding round-trips against a fixture.
+- [ ] `tool_result` blocks merge into the user turn and sort by call order.
+- [ ] `developer` and `latest_reminder` roles render.
+- [ ] Round-trip parity with the Python reference on a fixture set of conversations — byte-identical rendered strings, not "looks right".
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXLMTests/DeepseekV4ChatEncoderTests.swift` with checked-in fixtures: input conversation JSON + expected rendered prompt string generated from DeepSeek's Python `encoding_dsv4.py`.
+- [ ] Test: at least 8 fixture conversations covering each behavior above render byte-identically.
+- [ ] Test: tools present ⇒ earlier reasoning retained; tools absent + `drop_earlier_reasoning` ⇒ earlier reasoning dropped.
+- [ ] Test: `eos_token_id == 1` resolves from a fixture `tokenizer_config.json` and decodes to `<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>`.
+- [ ] Test: `<｜User｜>`, `<｜Assistant｜>`, `<think>` survive a detokenizer round-trip as single special tokens (not split).
+- [ ] Run: `swift test --filter DeepseekV4ChatEncoderTests` — all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — generate the Python-rendered expected strings first and assert byte equality; anything looser will let a subtle spacing bug through.
